notification.title: MPESB Subedar & Sub-Inspector Recruitment Test 2026
notification.applicationFeeScSt: Rs 250 for eligible MP-domicile reserved candidates
notification.howToApply: Candidates must apply online through the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board recruitment portal. Complete the required candidate profile/registration, select the applicable Subedar/Sub-Inspector recruitment examination and post preferences, enter the required personal and educational details, upload documents as prescribed, pay the applicable examination/application fee and submit the application before the prescribed closing date. Candidates should verify all eligibility, domicile, physical and post-specific qualification requirements from the official rulebook before submission.

posts.title: Subedar
posts.ageRelaxationNotes: Age is reckoned as prescribed in the recruitment rules. The maximum age is generally 33 years for male candidates in the applicable unreserved/other-state category and 38 years for eligible MP-domicile female and reserved-category male candidates. Certain specified categories, including eligible inter-caste-married candidates, government employees/Nagar Sainik and Vikram Award winners, may receive additional relaxation under the applicable rules. Other-state candidates do not receive MP domicile reservation or age-relaxation benefits.

ageRelaxation.SC: +5 years for eligible MP-domicile male candidates

physicalCriteria.Vision: Without glasses: 6/9 in better eye and 6/12 in other eye; colour vision must satisfy the prescribed Ishihara test

posts.educationDetails: Bachelor's degree/graduation from a recognized university or an equivalent qualification. Candidates must also satisfy the prescribed MP domicile, age, physical, medical and other conditions applicable to the Subedar cadre.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in MPESB Subedar and Sub-Inspector Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: There are 507 advertised vacancies: 81 Subedar, 69 Sub Inspector (Special Armed Force), 312 Sub Inspector (District Police Force), 10 Sub Inspector (Arms), 9 Sub Inspector (Photo), 4 Sub Inspector (Questioned Documents) and 22 Sub Inspector (Finger Print).

faqs.question: What is the minimum qualification for the non-technical posts?
faqs.answer: Subedar, Sub Inspector (Special Armed Force) and Sub Inspector (District Police Force) require a Bachelor's degree/graduation from a recognized university or equivalent qualification.

faqs.question: What qualification is required for Sub Inspector (Arms)?
faqs.answer: A three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized technical university/institution or equivalent prescribed qualification is required.

faqs.question: What qualification is required for Sub Inspector (Photo), Questioned Documents and Finger Print?
faqs.answer: A Bachelor's degree/graduation with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry as prescribed subjects is required.

faqs.question: When does the application process start?
faqs.answer: Online applications are scheduled to start on 9 September 2026 and close on 23 September 2026. Application correction is available up to 28 September 2026.

faqs.question: When is the preliminary examination?
faqs.answer: The preliminary examination is scheduled to start from 28 October 2026.

faqs.question: Can candidates from other states apply?
faqs.answer: Candidates from other states may apply subject to the recruitment rules, but they do not receive MP-domicile reservation or MP-domicile age-relaxation benefits and are considered under the applicable unreserved/open provisions.
